description: Frozen Func Model performance matrix — provider row counts, hard workloads, sweep grids, runtime limits, and error policies. All decisions frozen from plan lines 48-73.

frozen_policies.no_silent_skip: Every case, row, workload, and sweep point MUST be executed. Skip flags, try/except swallowing, or empty-run deception are hard failures.
frozen_policies.no_duplicate_ids: All case_ids, workload_ids, and sweep_ids across the matrix must be unique.
frozen_policies.seed_fixed: Random seed=42 for all deterministic runs; no runtime seed injection.

error_policy.workload_path_error: total and major(>=5% of total) → <=20% per case; minor → abs_err <=2 cycles
error_policy.expected_noop: Exact-zero oracle and provider for no-op cases; non-zero/NaN/Inf fails

frozen_policies.rounding: math.ceil for integer cycles; no banker's rounding

sweep_grids.description: Sweep grids frozen from plan line 72. Each grid has a unique sweep_id and explicit value set.

bottleneck_endpoints.name: Memory-bound endpoint
bottleneck_endpoints.description: BW=6.4 GB/s with array=128; lowest bandwidth with largest array creates maximum memory bottleneck

bottleneck_endpoints.name: Compute-bound endpoint
bottleneck_endpoints.description: BW=102.4 GB/s with array=32; highest bandwidth with smallest array creates maximum compute bottleneck

qwen_canonical_layer_dag.description: Canonical Qwen layer DAG from docs/qwen25-3b-forward-spec.md. DMA/NoC/KV are expanded provider activities linked by parent operation ID.
